note: Third-party accelerators for the download page. Prefix mirrors get the GitHub asset URL appended. Hosts must stay on this list; the page re-validates every built URL against it. The first-party R2 link is NOT configured here: download.js renders it from /api/latest's verified `_cdn` verdict so it always points at the object that was checked against this release. No raw GitHub direct link is offered: the page is for networks where github.com is unusable.
